summary: Re-test of the 3 reported bugs. Backend: updated /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (now 33 pytest tests, ALL PASS) — replaced the old unit-stripped km/cc assertions with unit-INCLUSIVE ones, added a number-plate regex test, a live number_plate assertion + log assertion, and two browser-free code-review tests for dice.py (fill_dice_ratings robustness + fill_dice_form number_plate -> #exf_31). Live job on listing 6051385299 completed in ~14s: kilometer='39,000 km' (unit + source spacing preserved), engine_cc='2,996 cc', not swapped, number_plate='PNF703' with log '[TRADE ME] Number plate: PNF703' and no plate WARN, ask_price='$74,990', ratings 1.5/5/1.5/5, 5 photos on /photoserver/full/ (first reachable, >1KB), description 2118 chars, Dice skipped gracefully ('DICE_USERNAME / DICE_PASSWORD not set'), no crash. Error handling verified: empty/whitespace url -> 400, missing field -> 422, unknown status/close -> 404, 2nd concurrent start -> 409, logs stream incrementally. Static regex validation: km pattern returns '262,000km'/'39,000 km', cc returns '4477cc'/'4,477cc'/'2,996 cc', km pattern returns None on '4477cc' and cc pattern None on '262,000km' (no swap). Dice rating code review confirmed: None -> [SKIP] (leaves '- None -'), wait_for(state='attached'), select_option by value then label, numeric variants ('5' -> '5'/'5.0'), dispatch_event('change'), and '[ERROR] Could not select <field>=<value> ... Available options: [...]' dump on failure; #exf_41..#exf_44 mapping present. Live Dice selection NOT exercised (no creds) — logic/structure verified only. Frontend E2E (Playwright, 1920x1080): url-input + start-btn work, status-pill reached 'Completed' in 16s, field-kilometer='39,000 km', field-engine_cc='2,996 cc', field-number_plate='PNF703', all 4 rating-* testids populated (1.5/5/1.5/5), photo-grid rendered 5 images, 0 error elements, no console errors.

minor.issue: The generic \bplate fallback will capture the next UPPERCASE token after any occurrence of 'plate' (e.g. 'Number plate history\nNZ NEW' -> 'NZ'). Scope the search to the vehicle-details block or require the label to be a full line.

Candidate set is numeric-only ('5', '5.0', '3.5'). If Dice renders option labels as '5 stars' / '★★★★★' / 'Five', nothing is selected (only the option dump is logged). Recommend a final pass that picks the option whose inner text contains the numeric value (regex/contains match) before giving up.
PRE-EXISTING (it_1/it_2): listing.year='2021' while title='2022 Jaguar F-PACE ...' — body-text Year match wins over the title fallback.

PRE-EXISTING: in-memory _jobs dict has no TTL/eviction; close() only signals the Dice review wait, so a job stuck in the Trade Me/photo phase holds the single-active lock until Playwright timeouts elapse.

issues: 'Price' and 'Doors' rows always render '—' for this listing (Listing.price hard-coded None; doors not present on the page) — the 'Price' vs 'Asking Price' pair remains redundant.
The last grid row ('Carbon Emissions') leaves an empty right-hand cell with a visible border, looking like a missing field. Consider spanning the last item or filling with a placeholder.

action_items: Optional (robustness, not blocking): make the primary number-plate LABEL case-insensitive so it isn't dead code, and scope the \bplate fallback to the vehicle-details block.

Optional (robustness): in fill_dice_ratings add a contains/regex option-text fallback (e.g. option text matching the number) before logging the failure dump — current candidates only cover pure numeric labels.
Optional (pre-existing): fix year precedence (title model year vs body-text year, 2022 vs 2021).
Optional (UI): fill/span the trailing empty cell in the Extracted Vehicle Data grid.
critical_code_review_comments: trade_me.py: primary number-plate regex is case-sensitive on the label and therefore never matches 'Number plate'; the feature silently depends on the looser \bplate fallback.
dice.py fill_dice_ratings: robust for numeric option values/labels but has no substring/regex option matching, so non-numeric Dice labels would still fail (logged, not silent — acceptable).

trade_me.py: km fallback (?<![\d/])((?:...|\d{4,})\s*km)\b still scans the WHOLE body_text and can match an odometer-like number inside the free-text description; same whole-page keyword scan risk applies to fuel/transmission/body_type.
server.py: child stderr is merged into logs unprefixed, so tracebacks are indistinguishable from normal log lines.
seed_data_creation: None. Live Trade Me listing 6051385299; photos downloaded to /app/temp_photos.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md does not exist. Not required — app has no auth; Dice creds intentionally unset (dice_configured=false via /api/health and 'Dice creds not set' chip).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v -p no:randomly` (~30s, 33 tests). Only one job at a time (2nd start -> 409); keep job tests sequential (module-scoped completed_job fixture retries once after 60s). TestExtractionRules is browser-free: km/cc patterns now expect the UNIT INCLUDED ('262,000km', '39,000 km', '4,477cc', '2,996 cc'); number-plate test replicates the two-pattern case-sensitive logic; two tests assert dice.py fill_dice_ratings structure (skip-None, wait_for attached, value/label, '5.0' variant, change event, option dump) and #exf_31/#exf_41-44 config mapping — update them if dice.py changes. Verified values for 6051385299: kilometer='39,000 km', engine_cc='2,996 cc', number_plate='PNF703', ask_price='$74,990', ratings 1.5/5/1.5/5, 5 photos, description 2118 chars, year='2021' (known nit). Live Dice login/rating selection remains untestable without creds.
rca_of_the_issue: All 3 reported bugs are fixed and verified. (1) Number plate: extraction now succeeds and reaches the UI/#exf_31 as 'PNF703' (via the case-insensitive-by-accident \bplate fallback — see minor issue). (2) Units restored: find_first capture groups now include the trailing unit inside group(1) while preserving source spacing, and the two patterns are unit-specific so km/cc can never swap. (3) fill_dice_ratings now waits for the select, tries value then label plus numeric variants, dispatches change, and dumps available options on failure instead of silently passing; it also skips None so untouched dropdowns stay '- None -'. Only remaining risk is non-numeric Dice option labels, which would be logged as [ERROR] rather than silently ignored.
